subject: Post-demo: vendor intake & PO timeline (Horizon Health)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <s.ortiz@horizonhealth.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 14:08:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: vendor intake & PO timeline (Horizon Health)

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Great to meet you on the demo earlier. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we can align next steps: 

- Scope recap: pilot with 2 internal teams (Clinical Insights + Patient Ops), expected pilot volume ~100K tokens/day.
- Success criteria you mentioned: 1) <200ms median latency for short prompts, 2) <1.5 cost multiplier vs current pipeline, 3) no PHI persistence in hosted logs.

Actions we need to unblock procurement and onboarding:
1) Procurement contact + vendor intake owner at Horizon (name/email).
2) Legal/InfoSec questionnaire route (who owns the SOC2 review + timeline).
3) PO process: typical lead times, required docs (W-9, tax forms), and invoice remittance details.

I attached our Redwood vendor intake form to speed the process (redwood-vendor-intake-form.pdf). If you can share the preferred procurement contact and an expected PO timeline (e.g., procurement committee dates), we’ll prioritize getting the vendor packet ready.

Proposed next dates: procurement board week of 11/16–11/20? We can aim to have completed intake + SOW to you by 11/11 to meet that window. Does that align?

Thanks — I’ll loop in Marissa and Aditya to prepare the paperwork once we have the procurement contact.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | 415-555-0182

Attachment: redwood-vendor-intake-form.pdf (fillable, 3 pages)
From: Samantha Ortiz <s.ortiz@horizonhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: vendor intake & PO timeline (Horizon Health)

Karthik — thanks for the clear recap.

A few notes from our side: 
- Procurement owner: Tom Reynolds (tom.reynolds@horizonhealth.com) — I’ve CC’d him here. He’ll handle vendor intake and PO routing.
- Legal/IS: onboarding questionnaires go to Maria Gutierrez in InfoSec (m.gutierrez@horizonhealth.com). She typically takes ~7–10 business days to do an initial risk review.
- Timeline: Procurement committee meets 11/20 for non-strategic SaaS vendors. If we get the intake + SOW by 11/11, we should be on the 11/20 agenda and, assuming no major issues, PO issuance target is ~12/01.
- Required docs for PO: completed vendor packet, W-9 (for US vendors), vendor remit address, and an invoice template.

I’m attaching the Horizon vendor questionnaire that InfoSec prefers to see early (HH-vendor-questionnaire.xlsx).

Sound good — Tom, can you confirm the PO contact and whether we need any CU-related forms for tax/GL mapping?

Best,
Samantha Ortiz
Director, Clinical Ops — Horizon Health
(s.ortiz@horizonhealth.com)

Can you help with the following by EOD 11/11 so we hit the 11/20 committee?
- Marissa: finalize vendor packet + completed W-9 + invoice template. Please include a short payment remittance note (how Redwood prefers to receive PO/invoice).
- Aditya: SOW draft tailored to Clinical Insights + Patient Ops pilot (est. token volumes, termination clause for pilot, data handling language aligned to ‘no PHI persistence’). Also run InfoSec checklist for any obvious gaps against HH-vendor-questionnaire.xlsx.

Thanks — I’ll then upload the completed packet to their portal and confirm the 11/11 delivery.

Karthik
